results.description: Three years after Hogwarts, Harry Potter’s world has grown quiet—too quiet. But when mysterious forces stir beyond the veil of known magic, Harry, Hermione, and Ron are thrust into a breathtaking journey across dimensions where the rules of magic are rewritten with every step. Ancient tomes breathe, interdimensional councils plot, and powerful beings—like the fearsome Voidheart—threaten the delicate balance between realms. Packed with peril, wonder, and the thrill of rediscovering magic’s deepest secrets, this is Harry Potter as you’ve never seen him before—facing not just the darkness outside, but the unknown within.
